notes.title: Teaser & Release Date for Garfield Kart 2 - All You Can Drift 🐈🏎️
notes.notes:
Hello lasagna lovers 🍝

[h3]Out of the garage and on to the road! Garfield Kart 2 - All You Can Drift will drift its way to PC and console on September 10th![/h3]

[previewyoutube=meQD_cRQyjU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Did you know?[/h3]
In [i]Garfield Kart 2 - All You Can Drift[/i], you can play against [b]up to eight players online worldwide[/b], or enjoy [b]local multiplayer mode for up to four players with split-screen mode[/b]! Perfect for frenzied competitions between friends or on family game nights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636063/1c5b43f47fcd0e97fc140756aa6efd9ba6038396.jpg[/img]
[h3]Ready to race against a real heavyweight?[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
